thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: HIGH error-rate alert from model-catalog (entry=search-qa). Rule= catalog-config-errors sustained >5m. Promoted revision: rev-2026-04-11-rc3. Routing: eng-oncall.

maria chen: ack. I'll take first responder. @ajay can you pull logs and confirm root pattern? I'll notify customer-ops after initial triage.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Acknowledged by maria chen. Escalation suspended.

ajay singh: seeing a flood of tokenizer exceptions in the model loader; runtime is falling back to CPU decode which is thrashing memory leading to OOM retries and 502s.
ajay singh: paste from runtime logs:
```
ERROR load: tokenizer_map.lookup("bytepair-broken") -> NotFound
WARN runtime: falling back to generic decode -> CPU path
ERROR inference: OOM during kv-cache alloc, retry -> request failed 502
```
ajay singh: quick diff: promoted catalog entry changed `default_tokenizer` from `utf8_bpe` -> `bytepair-broken` and set `quant_profile: fp16` as default. Promotion CI didn't catch tokenizer name mismatch.

sam: that was my promotion yesterday for the search-qa rollout; I used a local tokenizer alias and apparently the CI's canonical tokenizer list didn't include it. sorry everyone.

jules: taking oncall in 10. @maria gather customer impact and I'll coordinate comms + timeline.

ajay singh: impact snapshot (last 10m): three tenants with notable error spikes and latency regressions: acme-inc (search), blueledger (query), nimbus-ai (similar). 5xx rate for those customers jumped to ~12% at peak.

maria chen: mitigation proposal:
1) rollback catalog entry to rev-2026-04-09-stable
2) emergency routing rule to send traffic for affected customers to the stable variant
3) temporarily disable promotions that do not pass tokenizer validation

maria chen: running rollback now:
```
rwd catalog promote --entry search-qa --revision rev-2026-04-09-stable --reason "EMERGENCY rollback tokenizer/quant defaults"
```

deploy bot: Deploy bot: Promotion command submitted by maria chen. Job=deploy-99211. Status=running.

ajay singh: applying routing override for affected tenants while rollback proceeds. Patch applied via control-plane API:
```
PATCH /v1/routing/overrides
body:
  tenants: ["acme-inc","blueledger","nimbus-ai"]
  prefer_variant: stable
```

sam: also adding short-term rate-limit on catalog-promote API (100/min -> 10/min) and enabling canary-only promote mode until we have a fix.

deploy bot: Deploy bot: deploy-99211 completed successfully. Active revision now rev-2026-04-09-stable.

jules: takeover: good. I'm drafting customer messages. Opening incident tracker and assigning follow-ups:
- INF-3102: add tokenizer validation to catalog CI (assignee: ajay singh)
- INF-3103: add quant-profile compatibility lint and preflight (assignee: sam)
- OPS-1401: retro and update playbook for catalog promotions (assignee: maria chen)
- COMM-671: customer-facing postmortem + emails (assignee: jules)

leo kim: runtime suggestion: add a hard guard that rejects unknown tokenizer names during model load (fast-fail) and emit clear error to catalog validation pipeline.

ajay singh: will implement runtime guard + unit tests and add mapping health-checks to CI.

maria chen: customer impact summary for postmortem: three paying customers experienced elevated 5xx and degraded search latency for roughly 12 minutes during the promotion window. Errors originated from tokenizer lookup failures and subsequent runtime fallbacks; no model outputs were exposed incorrectly and no data exfiltration suspected.

jules: customer comms draft: short incident summary, root cause (catalog promotion with invalid tokenizer + incompatible quant defaults), immediate mitigation (rollback + routing override), and next steps (CI/runtime fixes, postmortem link). I'll post to #customer-success and notify account owners.

sam: adding an operational guard: block promote-from-local flag until CI enforces tokenizer canonicalization. Also scheduling two days of canary-only promotions.

maria chen: handing off to jules for comms and follow-ups. I'll stay available for 30 more minutes then hand off further actions to ops. Great job triaging everyone.

jules: creating incident doc now with timeline, logs, and screenshots of the catalog diff. Will attach CI run and promotion commit. Will mark pager resolved once comms dispatched.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident resolved by maria chen. Pager closed.

maria chen: resolve note: rollback succeeded, routing override in place for affected tenants, follow-up tickets created. Retro scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT.

jules: :white_check_mark: I'll publish the postmortem after the retro and include code snippets and the catalog diff. Closing thread.
